start: GitHub Actions page, workflow 'Play store listing (pictures in order)'

steps.action: Press 'Run workflow' with both boxes off
user_sees: Steps 'Self-tests (Play scripts)', 'Google sign-in (keyless, Workload Identity Federation)'
must_not: A key file created for the sign-in

steps.action: Step 'Upload the store pictures in order'
must_not: The screenshots in a different order than shot-01 to shot-08
A commit when the order Play reports is not the one uploaded

start: Run the listing workflow with 'Also set the title / short / full description from listing-draft.txt'

user_sees: 'Listing text set: title ..., short N chars, ...'
must_not: A title or description cut by Play without a word

start: Listing text too long, or Play reports a wrong picture order

steps.action: listing-draft.txt has a short description over Play's limit
user_sees: '<field> is N characters; Play allows M'; run red

steps.action: Play reports a different order after the upload
user_sees: 'Play reports ..., expected .... Edit discarded; nothing changed on Play.'

steps.action: Tick 'Dry run: validate on Play, never commit'
must_not: The live listing changed by a dry run
